prompt: An agent is configured to run autonomously in a CI pipeline. A deployment step begins to behave unexpectedly mid-execution. Which capability allows the system to recover without full manual intervention?
explanation: Correct answer: B) Rollback procedures and escalation paths configured as part of the agent's error handling strategy

options.text: Increasing the CI runner's compute resources
Rollback procedures and escalation paths configured as part of the agent's error handling strategy
Switching to a different CI platform
